items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: I met Miss Eleanor Powell there. She was a student of Buddy Bradley

ctx.x: Explain what you were just telling me.

Well now, she was taking care of us, see, and I used to see this portrait of Mr. Buddy Bradley. He was about the greatest tap dance teacher that they had. He had students like Eleanor Powell. Really, first he had Ruby Keeler and some other lady that became famous in the movies. I think her name was Arlene Judge and I think another one that became famous in the movies. Yeah, --
